Ambush: For each started 500 points of game size, one "Ambush marker" may be set up on the battlefield after all Infiltrators have been deployed, but before the first battle round starts.
 
- The marker must be set up at least 12" away from any enemy unit and at least 6" away from a mission objective or another Ambush marker.
- Units entering play from reserves with the "Ambush" rule may be set up within 3" of it and be given any kind of order. 
- Any creature unit with the "Ambush" rule may "embark" into a marker like a transport vehicle, be removed from the field and put into reserves. 
- Units that enter reserves in this way automatically arrive during the Reinforcemente phase in the next battle round. 
- They do count towards the limit of how many units may arrive from reserves each round.
- If an enemy unit is within 3" of an Ambush marker during the Reinforcement phase, the marker is removed for the rest of the game.
